notes: The page opens a section entitled Le théorème de Griffiths par voie algébrique. It fixes a proper smooth f:Y→S, adds regularity of S by hand, and takes a constant twisted adic coefficient sheaf.

It defines primitive x by vanishing of its image in H^0(S,R^m f_*(F)) and states equivalence with vanishing on a geometric fibre. The page then assigns u(x) in E_2^{1,m-1}=H^1(S,R^{m-1}f_*(F_Y)). These are readings of claims, not proofs.

It introduces a cohomological correspondence of degree N on Y x_S Y-prime, an action H^{m-prime}(Y-prime,F-prime)→H^m(Y,F), a coefficient pairing to F(d-prime), and the naturality formula u(Z(x-prime))=Z(u(x-prime)). The final sentence continues beyond this page.
The source alternates a doubtful capital-sized correspondence-class letter, clear lower-case z in prose, and later clear capital Z. This variation is preserved.

The degree equation has genuine replacement handwriting. The conditional degree calculation explains why 2d-prime would be mathematically compatible, but the transcription retains uncertainty rather than supplying that reading from mathematics.
R^m in the inline H^0 expression is clean type. H's blanket description of three overdrawn m exponents is not supported at that locus.
The source uses F rather than an added F_Y in the inline primitive condition. No mathematically convenient Y is restored.

No authorial words of doubt are present on this page. The phrase il en est évidemment de même is an assertion, and NB introduces a parenthesis; neither is a reservation. All uncertainty markers in this return are the reader's.

The title prefix and body corrections cannot be assigned to a named individual from ink alone. Brown prefix, black title, pen repairs and pencil-like archive number are described by visible medium only.
Faint disconnected upper-left traces are inventoried but not expanded into a word, numeral or authorial diagram. No other diagram or independent drawing was found.

All ordinary prose, punctuation, accents, primes, the typed x product sign, geometric-point bars, six display boundaries, and the final continuing sentence (comma after également, no terminal stop) were read from the two halves. C-H agreement was not treated as evidence.

check_events.outcome: On the displayed live indices, 1+(m-1)=m. This checks total degree only; no spectral-sequence degeneration, edge-map injectivity or functoriality theorem was proved.

Assuming cup product with a degree-N class raises degree by N and pushforward along relative dimension d-prime lowers it by 2d-prime, the output degree is m-prime+N-2d-prime. This arithmetic is compatible with the uncertain handwritten 2d-prime, but does not resolve its ink or prove the correspondence formalism.

brief_feedback: The packet refers to an attached PREAMBLE but does not supply one; only listed macros and standard LaTeX were used. It would help to specify whether a clearly chi-shaped mechanical substitute must be encoded literally or as ell, how mixed typed/handwritten circled signs should be rendered, and how uncertain edge/offset traces should be inventoried without asserting authorial content. No additional crop or page was opened to settle these policy questions.
